name: iot-dashboard
description: Mini IoT Dashboard & Device Management Platform (MVP)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @iot/backend" "npm run dev -w @iot/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @iot/backend && npm run build -w @iot/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @iot/backend && npm run typecheck -w @iot/frontend
